The WAF SSLO L2 Engineer will be a key member of our network security team, responsible for the operational support, administration, and maintenance of the bank's Web Application Firewall and SSL Orchestration platforms. This role focuses on protecting critical banking applications and sensitive data from modern web threats while ensuring compliance with stringent financial regulations.   • Provide Level 2 operational support for F5 BIG-IP systems, specifically for WAF (ASM) and SSL Orchestrator (SSLO) modules.

  • Manage and deploy Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies and security policies, including managing exceptions and performing policy tuning.
  • Perform configuration changes and updates on F5 SSL Orchestrator for decrypting, inspecting, and re-encrypting SSL/TLS traffic.
  • Implement standard configurations for new applications and services as per design guidelines and bank policies.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and a knowledge base for incident resolution.
  • Lead the troubleshooting efforts for security incidents, providing accurate root cause analysis (RCA).
  • Ensure that F5 WAF and SSLO configurations are compliant with the bank's security policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Shall analyze incidents identify root causes and act for containment and remediation.
  • Shall co-ordinate with the different departments/stakeholders for incident analysis and remedial action.
  • Provides engineering analysis and architectural design of technical solutions.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
The Senior Associate Information Security Analyst is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for designing and implementing security systems to protect the organization's computer networks from cyber-attacks, and to help set and maintain security standards.
This role is required to monitor the organization's computer networks for security issues, install security software, and document any security issues or breaches found.
The Senior Associate Information Security Analyst is responsible for assisting in the planning, implementation, and management of information security measures to safeguard the organization's digital assets and systems and contributes to maintaining a secure and compliant environment.
Key responsibilities
  • Monitors security alerts and events from various sources, investigates potential threats, and escalates incidents as necessary.
  • Assists in the implementation and monitoring of security controls, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls.
  • Performs regular vulnerability assessments, analyses scan results, and assists in prioritizing and remediating identified vulnerabilities.
  • Supports the incident response team in investigating security incidents, documenting findings, and participating in remediation efforts.
  • Assists in ensuring compliance with industry standards (for example, GDPR, ISO 27001) by conducting assessments and implementing necessary controls.
  • Installs security measures and operates software to protect systems and information infrastructure, including firewalls and data encryption programs.
  • Documents security breaches and assess the damage they cause.
  • Works with the security team to perform tests and uncover network vulnerabilities.
  • Fixes detected vulnerabilities to maintain a high-security standard.
  • Develops organizational best practices for IT security.
  • Performs penetration testing and upgrades systems to unable security software.
  • Installs and upgrades antivirus software and tests and evaluates new technology.
  • Assists with the installation of security software and understands information security management.
  • Researches security enhancements and makes recommendations to management.
  • Stays abreast of information technology trends and security standards.
  • Contributes to security awareness initiatives by creating training materials, conducting workshops, and educating employees about best security practices.
  • Maintains accurate records of security incidents, assessments, and actions taken for reporting and audit purposes.
  • Assists in the management and maintenance of security tools, including antivirus software, encryption tools, and security information and event management (SIEM) systems.
  • Participates in risk assessments to identify potential security threats, vulnerabilities, and associated risks to the organization.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, IT, and other teams to ensure security measures are integrated into the organization's processes and projects.
  • Performs any other related task as required.
Requirements
  • Good communication skills to effectively convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to prevent hacking on a network.
  • Ability to identify and evaluate potential risks and to develop solutions.
  • Ability to identify and mitigate network vulnerabilities and explain how to avoid them.
  • Understands firewalls, proxies, SIEM, antivirus, and IDPS concepts.
  • Understands patch management with the ability to deploy patches in a timely manner whilst understanding business impact.
  • Developing proficiency with MAC and OS.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks, standards, and regulations (for example, NIST, CIS, GDPR).
  • Basic understanding of network and system architecture, protocols, and security controls.
  • Ability to analyze security incidents and assess potential risks.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Academic qualifications and certifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in information security, cybersecurity, computer science, or related.
  • Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) are advantageous.
Required experience
  • Moderate level of demonstrated experience in information security or cybersecurity, or related roles.
  • Moderate level of demonstrated experience working in a global IT organization.
  • Moderate level of demonstrated experience with computer network penetration testing and techniques.
  • Moderate level of demonstrated experience with security assessment and vulnerability scanning tools.
Workplace type: On-site

Role Summary
NTT Data is seeking -- years of experienced Enterprise Messaging Integration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise-grade messaging, integration, and workload automation platforms. Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
Key Responsibilities
  • Messaging Platform Administration (IBM MQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ). Install, configure, upgrade, and secure messaging platforms. Create and manage messaging artifacts: queue managers, queues, topics, channels, listeners, security settings, retention policies. Implement HA/DR, clustering, replication, and multi-node failover strategies. Performance tuning: throughput optimization, message persistence, batch sizes, connection pools, buffer/log tuning. Monitor health metrics using dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Splunk) and handle incidents proactively. Troubleshoot message flow failures, dead-letter queues, consumer lag, stuck messages, and network bottlenecks.

Build and manage BAR files, integration nodes, servers, policies, and environment overrides. Implement integration security: TLS/mTLS, OAuth/JWT, Basic Auth, certificate management. Troubleshoot and optimize integration flows for latency, throughput, parser efficiency, and memory footprint. Participate in CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, unit testing, and environment migrations.
  • IoT Telemetry Messaging (IBM MQXR / MQTT). Configure and support MQXR Telemetry listeners, MQTT topics, subscriptions, and QoS policies. Secure MQTT clients using TLS certificates, access control, and throttling policies. Monitor MQTT client connections, sessions, retained messages, and message routing to backend MQ systems.
  • Workload Automation (IBM TWS / IWS). Install, upgrade, configure, and administer TWS/IWS masters, controllers, and agents. Build job streams, calendars, dependencies, event triggers, and SLA monitoring. Troubleshoot job failures, optimize schedules, and implement recovery workflows. Integrate workload scheduler with MQ, REST APIs, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications.
  • Security, Governance Compliance. Implement end to end security for messaging and integration technologies: TLS/SSL, mTLS, JAAS, CHLAUTH policies, RBAC, OAuth/SASL. Perform auditing reporting for security compliance frameworks. Ensure platform hardening, certificate rotation, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Automation, DevOps Observability. Create automation scripts as Shell, Python, PowerShell for deployments, housekeeping, and monitoring. Build IaC templates (Ansible, Terraform) for consistent provisioning. Integrate platforms into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI). Maintain dashboards for real time system health and SLA adherence.

title: Senior QA/QC Data Analyst with AI/ML testing
jobDescription:
Req ID: phone_number
Job Summary
We are currently seeking a Senior QA/QC Data Analyst with AI/ML testing to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
Responsibilities
  • Take responsibility for the project and work independently in a collaborative environment.
  • Evaluate data across various dimensions, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, timeliness, uniqueness, and integrity.
  • Establish quality criteria for data accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, and AI model performance.
  • Test data ingestion, transformation (ETL/ELT), and outputs to ensure source-to-target integrity.
  • Verify that datasets used for AI/ML are accurate, representative, unbiased, and fit for purpose.
  • Validate model metrics against defined business and technical thresholds, including accuracy, precision, recall, and stability.
  • Identify and assess bias, fairness issues, and unintended impacts in data and AI model outcomes.
  • Implement automated tests for data validation, model regression, and pipeline checks within CI/CD and MLOps workflows.
  • Log, prioritize, and track data and AI defects; perform root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Validate adherence to data governance, privacy, security, and AI regulatory requirements.
  • Track data drift, model drift, anomalies, and performance degradation post-deployment.
  • Communicate quality status, risks, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders before and after releases.
  • Design and develop testing plans, test cases, and test scripts to evaluate data quality.
  • Identify, document, and report defects, inconsistencies, and inaccuracies.
  • Maintain and update testing documentation and report on test outcomes.
  • Document key data processes and transformations.
  • Assist with quality improvement initiatives and recommend improvements to data quality processes and procedures.
  • Assist developers, business stakeholders, and data governance teams in meeting data quality standards.
  • Knowledge of the Agile/Waterfall approach and how quality assurance fits into it.
  • Create automated testing solutions from scratch.
  • Develop testing scenarios by analyzing feature requirements for the purpose of estimating testing effort.
  • Track defects, analyze and communicate test results, and engage in daily QA activities.
Skills and Abilities
  • Ability to take ownership of the project and work independently in a team environment.
  • Ability to analyze problems, perform root cause analysis, and develop solutions essential for resolving data issues.
  • Proficient in PyTest/unit test frameworks used for ML testing automation.
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as C#, Python, or R for data process automation and analysis.
  • Proficient in automated test suite development for ML models.
  • Working knowledge of ML-specific API testing (e.g., inference endpoints).
  • Working knowledge of automated metrics validation for model outputs.
  • Expertise in the principles and testing procedures.
  • Working knowledge of data validation frameworks such as Great Expectations.
  • Working knowledge of ML-oriented data pipeline tools.
  • Working knowledge of validation for massive, ML-ready datasets.
  • Proficient in ML-specific QA strategy (model tests, feature tests, data contracts, drift tests).
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD integration for ML (MLOps).
  • Proficient in model-centric regression testing.
  • Proficient in testing lineage, reproducibility, and experiment tracking.
  • Proficient in developing and maintaining test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test defect tracking, summary reporting, and test scripts to perform thorough testing and validate the data, based on business requirements.
  • Familiarity with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tools to move and transform data.
  • Working knowledge of AI governance framework, ethical AI compliance, bias monitoring policies, and model traceability requirements.
  • Working knowledge of debugging tools (Fiddler).
  • Proficiency with version control practices using Git, including branching, collaboration, reviewing pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts.
  • Knowledge of build servers (Azure CICD Pipeline, Jenkins, and Cruise Control).
  • Working knowledge of source control systems (DevOps, GitHub, SVN, or TFS).
  • Working experience in release management and bug tracking tools (e.g., Zephyr, etc.).
  • Knowledge of HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Angular Bootstrap, SQL, SharePoint, JSON, or XML objects.
  • Knowledge of API testing using Postman and Swagger UI.
  • Knowledge of Azure cloud infrastructure and its capabilities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are needed to explain findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A willingness to learn new tools and adapt to evolving technologies is important for long-term career growth.

Job Summary
The AI Data Engineering Lead owns the design, build, governance, and operational readiness of the data pipelines, data products, knowledge assets, and retrieval-ready datasets required to power AI-enabled products.
This role ensures that AI products are not built on fragmented, low-quality, ungoverned, or inaccessible data. The AI Data Engineering Lead works across product, data architecture, AI engineering, platform engineering, security, risk, compliance, MLOps/LLMOps, and operations to ensure that AI products use trusted, permissioned, explainable, and reusable data and knowledge assets.
Job Details
Title: Expert Data Engineer
Shift: 11:00AM - 8:00PM
Work Mode: Hybrid
Location: Bangalore
Responsibilities
  • Own AI-ready data engineering. The AI Data Engineering Lead is accountable for engineering data assets that AI products can safely and effectively use.
  • Build and manage data pipelines that support AI-enabled applications, RAG solutions, agents, analytics, automation, and decision-support capabilities.
  • Ensure data used by AI products is complete, accurate, timely, traceable, and fit for purpose.
  • Create reusable data products that can serve multiple products, business units, and AI use cases.
  • Partner with product owners and AI engineers to define what data is required for prompts, retrieval, grounding, classification, extraction, recommendations, and workflow automation.
  • Ensure AI data assets are engineered for scale, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and production support.
  • Define data products for key domains such as client, entity, product, service, transaction, finance, risk, vendor, employee, jurisdiction, and reference data.
  • Establish clear data product ownership, service levels, quality expectations, refresh frequency, and access rules.
  • Create data pipelines that support both transactional product needs and AI/analytics needs.
  • Define source-of-truth usage and reduce reliance on uncontrolled spreadsheets, local files, and duplicate extracts.
  • Ensure data products are documented, discoverable, versioned, and reusable.
  • Partner with data stewards to resolve quality, definition, and ownership issues.
  • Prepare policies, procedures, contracts, regulatory content, service playbooks, product documentation, client obligations, and operational knowledge for AI retrieval.
  • Define document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, refresh, and retirement processes.
  • Partner with AI engineering to design vector stores, semantic search, retrieval ranking, grounding, and citation patterns.
  • Ensure retrieval sources are approved, current, versioned, owned, and access-controlled.
  • Validate that AI products retrieve the right content for the right user in the right context.
  • Prevent AI products from using obsolete, conflicting, unauthorized, or unapproved knowledge sources.
  • Define data quality rules for critical data elements used by AI products.
  • Monitor completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, validity, consistency, and timeliness.
  • Build automated quality checks into pipelines.
  • Create exception handling, issue management, and remediation workflows.
  • Partner with data owners and product teams to prioritize data quality fixes based on business and AI impact.
  • Ensure AI products can identify when data is missing, stale, conflicting, or unreliable.
  • Provide evidence of data quality for product acceptance, risk review, and operational readiness.
  • Capture metadata for datasets, data products, APIs, pipelines, reports, knowledge assets, vector indexes, and AI retrieval sources.
  • Ensure data and knowledge assets are cataloged and discoverable.
  • Define business and technical metadata needed for AI use.
  • Document lineage from source systems through pipelines, transformations, vector stores, prompts, outputs, and consuming products.
  • Support auditability by making source-to-output traceability visible where required.
  • Partner with data governance teams to ensure definitions, ownership, sensitivity, and usage rules are documented.
  • Implement role-based, attribute-based, jurisdictional, client-specific, and purpose-based access controls.
  • Ensure AI products only use data that users, applications, models, and agents are authorized to access.
  • Partner with security and privacy teams to classify data sensitivity.
  • Prevent sensitive data from being exposed through prompts, logs, embeddings, outputs, or retrieved content.
  • Ensure data minimization, retention, masking, encryption, and audit logging requirements are met.
  • Design data access patterns that work across applications, APIs, data products, vector stores, and AI agents.
  • Support security and privacy reviews for AI-enabled products.
  • Monitor pipeline reliability, latency, and freshness.

Senior Business Analyst - RPA & Agentic AI
About the Role
We build agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions for enterprise clients across construction, finance, procurement, healthcare and real estate. This role sits at the front of delivery: you will run discovery with client business teams, translate messy real-world processes into clear requirements, and stay with the solution through build, UAT and go-live.
This is not a documentation-only role. You are expected to understand how RPA bots and AI agents actually work, challenge scope, and design processes that automation can realistically deliver.
What You ll Do
  • Lead requirement gathering workshops with client stakeholders - process owners, finance, procurement, IT and operations.
  • Map as-is processes, identify automation candidates, and design to-be process flows with clear human-in-the-loop control points.
  • Author BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
  • Build the business case: baseline effort, volumes, error rates, cycle times, and projected ROI for each use case.
  • Define agent scope - what the agent decides autonomously, what it recommends, and where a human must approve.
  • Work with solution architects and developers to validate feasibility across RPA platforms, LLM-based agents, and ERP/system integrations.
  • Own UAT: build test scenarios, coordinate client testing, track defects to closure.
  • Support change management - SOP updates, user training material, and adoption tracking post go-live.
  • Manage scope and expectations across multiple concurrent client engagements.
Must-Have Qualifications
  • Minimum 4 years as a Business Analyst, with at least 2 years on RPA and/or AI/agentic AI delivery projects.
  • Demonstrable end-to-end delivery experience - you have taken at least two automation or AI use cases from discovery through to production.
  • Strong process analysis skills: process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), gap analysis, exception handling design.
  • Proven BRD/FRD/user story authoring ability - please be prepared to walk us through a document you have written.
  • Excellent client-facing communication comfortable running workshops with senior stakeholders and pushing back when a request is not feasible.
  • Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Finance or a related field.
Relevant Technologies (hands-on or working exposure)
RPA & low-code automation
  • UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, or Power Automate (Desktop & Cloud)
  • Microsoft Power Platform - Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse
Agentic AI & LLM tooling
  • Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent agent frameworks
  • RAG architectures, prompt design, vector stores, document intelligence / OCR (Azure Document Intelligence, ABBYY)
  • Understanding of agent evaluation, guardrails, hallucination risk and audit/traceability requirements

  • ERP exposure - Oracle Fusion, SAP, Dynamics 365, or a construction/finance ERP
  • Familiarity with APIs and integration patterns (REST, webhooks) ability to read a Swagger/Postman collection
  • SQL for data validation and volume analysis
  • Documentation & delivery tooling - Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio / Lucid / draw.io
  • Domain depth in procurement, finance/AP, HSE, contracts, or inventory processes.

  • Experience delivering to UAE / GCC clients and comfort working to Gulf business hours where an engagement requires it.
  • Certification in UiPath BA, Microsoft PL-600 / AI-102, CBAP, or Agile/Scrum.
  • Experience sizing and pricing automation opportunities as part of a proposal or pre-sales cycle.

descriptionFromApi:
Senior QA Test Engineer - Shop Scan (Automation AI-Enabled)

Overview

Role Purpose
Ensure high-quality delivery of the Shop Scan platform by designing, automating, and executing robust test
scenarios across the full product lifecycle. This role combines functional validation, automation engineering,
and AI-assisted testing practices to maximise regression coverage, accelerate feedback cycles, and improve
release confidence.

Project Context

Shop Scan is a consumer research platform where household members scan purchases through a mobile
application, generating valuable behavioural insights. The QA role is critical to ensuring seamless end-to-end
user journeys, accurate reward processing, and secure, reliable platform behaviour.

Role Scope

This role acts as the primary QA owner for Shop Scan, defining and driving the quality approach across
functional, automated, and AI-assisted testing practices. The scope extends beyond execution to include test
strategy, automation framework maturity, regression optimisation, defect prevention, release readiness, and
continuous improvement. In a lean Agile environment, the role requires strong autonomy, sound judgement,
and close collaboration with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure quality is embedded
early in the delivery lifecycle.

Testing Process

- Quality Planning Test Design

The role analyses User Stories and technical requirements, challenges ambiguity early, and ensures clear,
testable acceptance criteria are in place for each delivery item.
Comprehensive test scenarios are designed across functional, negative, and edge-case coverage, with
appropriate preconditions, test data, and reusable test assets to support efficient execution.
The role maintains and evolves the regression test suite in line with product priorities, ensuring traceability
between requirements, coverage, defects, and release outcomes.

- Automation Strategy Framework Ownership

The role is responsible for developing and maintaining automated test coverage for regression testing, critical
business flows, and API validations. Automation must remain maintainable, scalable, and aligned with sprint
delivery, with a continuous focus on improving coverage, execution efficiency, and release of confidence.

- Test Execution, Defect Management Release Support

The role oversees execution of planned testing across automated, manual, exploratory, sanity, and release
validation activities, ensuring risks, blockers, and quality concerns are surfaced promptly and managed
proactively. Defects are logged with clear and structured evidence, including reproducibility detail, expected versus actual
behaviour, business impact, and severity assessment to support efficient triage and resolution.

- Clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence

- Actual versus expected results and impact on users or business flows

The role works closely with developers and stakeholders through defect triage, prioritisation, retesting, and
release readiness assessments to support informed go/no-go decisions.

- AI-Enabled Testing Practices

The role leverages AI tools to support test case generation from requirements, optimise regression test
selection, identify coverage gaps, and improve exploratory testing efficiency. It also contributes to the
adoption of practical AI-driven QA approaches across the team where they add measurable value.

- Validation, Quality Sign-off Continuous Improvement

Following defect resolution or delivery completion, the role validates outcomes across impacted areas and
ensures fixes meet the agreed quality standard before closure.
The role also identifies process, tooling, and coverage improvements to strengthen QA maturity over time
and improve overall delivery quality.

QA Responsibilities:

- Own the end-to-end QA approach for Shop Scan, ensuring test coverage is aligned to business
priorities, delivery risks, and release objectives.
- Drive automation adoption and framework improvement to increase regression efficiency,
repeatability, and release confidence.
- Collaborate with product owners, developers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements,
shape quality standards, and embed QA early in the delivery lifecycle.
- Provide quality visibility through clear reporting on risks, defects, test progress, and release
readiness.
- Champion best practice in test design, defect management, AI-enabled testing, and continuous
improvement to support a high-quality, scalable product.

title: Sr Frontend Engineer
jobDescription:
About Us
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services company and AWS Preferred Partner building governed, production-grade agentic AI systems. We partner with enterprises to deploy intelligent agents that automate complex business processes-from intelligent customer interactions to enterprise knowledge systems.

Experience: 4-8 years | 4+ years building complex, data-intensive or enterprise-grade frontend applications

The Role: You own major parts of the Kubogent frontend end to end: the control surface platform teams, M
L engineers, and application teams use to manage Kubernetes infrastructure, build AI/ML workloads, inspect experiments, operate models,
and understand what is happening across their environments.

Kubogent is not a conventional CRUD application. The frontend includes cluster and GPU management, project workspaces, notebooks, experiments, training and inference workflows, pipeline visualisation, live logs and events, browser terminals, model playgrounds, analytics, and administrative surfaces. You will take ambiguous product problems, decide how they should work, prototype the interaction model, and ship the result.

What youll do
  • Own complex product surfaces. Build and evolve dashboards, resource explorers, workflow editors, experiment views, model-serving interfaces, project workspaces, and administrative consoles used across the Kubogent platform.
  • Design it, then build it. There is no requirement that every feature arrives as a finished mockup. You take a product problem, understand the workflow, prototype an interaction model, and turn it into a polished production experience.
  • Own data-dense infrastructure views. Make clusters, nodes, GPUs, workloads, logs, events, quotas, experiments, and deployments understandable even when customers operate at significant scale.
  • Build real-time surfaces. Work with WebSockets, SSE, streaming logs, live status transitions, long-runningoperations, and high-frequency telemetry without compromising responsiveness or rendering performance.
  • Build interactive developer tools. Create experiences such as in-browser terminals, YAML/configuration editors,workflow or DAG visualisation, model playgrounds, notebook launch flows, and operational debugging interfaces.
  • Own frontend state architecture. Define patterns for server state, local state, optimistic updates, background refresh, async operations, error handling, and long-running workflow state.
  • Own the design system. Build reusable components, layout primitives, tokens, interaction patterns, and typedcontracts that keep the platform consistent as the product surface expands.
  • Shape multi-tenant UX. Make projects, organizations, clusters, permissions, roles, and resource boundaries clear to users without treating client-side checks as the security boundary.
  • Partner directly with backend and platform engineers. Influence API contracts, event models, pagination, filtering, workflow state machines, and product semantics rather than treating APIs as fixed inputs.
  • Keep the product fast. Establish performance budgets, profiling practices, virtualization strategies, bundlediscipline, and rendering patterns for large enterprise datasets.
  • Raise the production bar. Establish E2E coverage, frontend observability, error monitoring, test strategy, andrelease discipline.
  • Set the bar. Review code, mentor engineers, establish frontend standards, and help define what high-quality product engineering looks like at Aivar.

What were looking for
  • 4+ years building production frontend applications, with real depth in complex, data-intensive, infrastructure , developer-tooling , analytics, or enterprise products.
  • Deep React knowledge. Hooks, component architecture, rendering behaviour, memoization, state ownership, performance profiling, and the ability to explain why a component re-renders.
  • Strong TypeScript across UI components, API contracts, shared libraries, schemas, and application state.
  • You have built a genuinely hard product surface. Examples could include an IDE-like interface, workflow builder, graph editor, terminal, monitoring product, analytics console, infrastru cture dashboard, collaborative editor, or another interaction-heavy application.
  • You design, you dont just implement. You are comfortable starting from a workflow or product problem instead ofwaiting for final mocks.
  • Strong async-state fluency. WebSockets, SSE, polling, background jobs, live status updates, cancellation, retries,
  • reconnects, and partial failure.
  • Experience with data-dense interfaces. Filtering, sorting, pagination, virtualization, large tables, timelines, charts, logs, or event streams.
  • Design-system ownership. You have built or significantly evolved a component system other engineers relied on.
  • Strong API instincts. You can identify when an awkward frontend experience is actually caused by the wrong backend contract and work with backend engineers to fix it.
  • Production discipline. You have introduced or meaningfully improved E2E testing, CI, monitoring, performance measurement, or frontend reliability practices.
  • Comfort with cloud-native concepts. You do not need to be a Kubernetes expert, but concepts such as clusters, pods, deployments, namespaces, GPUs, jobs, logs, metrics, and RBAC should not intimidate you.
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools. We expect AI to carry routine implementation work so that you can spend moretime on architecture, interaction design, debugging, performance, and product decisions.

Strong pluses:
  • Experience building developer tools, cloud consoles, observability products, infrastruor internal developer platforms.
  • Monaco Editor, xterm.js, React Flow or similar graph/canvas libraries.
  • High-frequency charts, log viewers, terminal emulators, or workflow editors.
  • Experience with accessibility and keyboard-heavy power-user interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, MLflow, Argo Workflows, Ray, Prometheus, or similar infrastructure.

This role may not be the best match if:
  • Youprefer working primarily from predefined tickets and pixel-complete design handoffs. Were looking for someone who owns problems, drives solutions, and shapes the product.
  • Your experience is primarily marketing sites or straightforward CRUD applications. Kubogent has many highlystateful, real-time, infrastructure-heavy product surfaces.
  • You think frontend architecture ends at component structure. State models, API semantics, performance,workflows, failure states, and product interaction design are central to this role.

and understand what is happening across their environments.

The frontend includes cluster and GPU management, project workspaces, notebooks, experiments, training and inference workflows, pipeline visualisation, live logs and events, browser terminals, model playgrounds, analytics, and administrative surfaces.   • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to team members and ensuring code quality and adherence to coding standards.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in embedded systems to propose and integrate cutting-edge technologies into SolarEdges products.

  • Bachelors (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering with 4+ years of relevant industrial experience in embedded control firmware design and development ( Or )

About the Role

Glance AI is building AI-native consumer experiences for millions of users. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong consumer-product judgment, a high bar for user experience, and the ability to take ownership of large, ambiguous product problems.

You will own significant parts of the consumer experience end to end. That means identifying the right problems, defining the product and experience direction, aligning teams, driving execution, and owning the resulting user outcomes. We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between the big picture and the smallest interaction detail.

What You ll Own:

  • Own significant consumer journeys or product areas end to end.
  • Turn ambiguous user and business problems into a clear product and experience direction.
  • Define what should be built, why it matters, and how it should feel for the user.
  • Partner deeply with design to create simple, intuitive, and differentiated AI-native interactions.
  • Maintain a high bar for the complete user experience, not just feature functionality.
  • Drive outcomes across activation, engagement, retention, and repeat usage.
  • Make decisions where user behavior, technology, or the solution itself is still evolving.
  • Work with engineering teams to understand possibilities, limitations, failure modes, and trade offs.
  • Prioritize across competing opportunities and make difficult scope decisions.
  • Align stakeholders across design, engineering, AI, data, research, and business.
  • Surface risks early, unblock teams, and keep execution moving.
  • Use user insight, data, experimentation, and judgment to continuously improve the product.

What We re Looking For:

  • 4-7 years of product management experience, with strong consumer-product experience.
  • A track record of independently owning meaningful products, journeys, or problem spaces.
  • Strong product taste and a deep appreciation for UI, UX, and interaction design.
  • Ability to distinguish between adding functionality and creating a genuinely better user experience.
  • Strong understanding of consumer behavior and engagement.
  • Ability to create clarity and make decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • Strong prioritization and judgment, including knowing what not to build.
  • Strong stakeholder management and the ability to align teams without relying on authority.

We move fast, but we care deeply about the quality of the experience we put in front of users. We test, learn, and iterate without becoming attached to a particular design, feature, or roadmap. As a Data Engineer at Electrolux Global Data AI (GDAI) Team, you are the backbone of our digital supply chain for information - the person who turns raw, scattered data into reliable and trusted data and AI products. You will work across the full lifecycle of data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery, on our modern Lakehouse stack built on Azure Databricks. Like the Data Engineering teams at the worlds largest tech companies, we hold a high bar: we hire builders who think like owners, dive deep into ambiguous problems, and are equally comfortable architecting a pipeline as they are explaining a metric to a business stakeholder. title: Associate Product Manager
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Job Title: Associate Product Manager

Location: Bengaluru

We are seeking an Associate Product Manager to lead strategic initiatives and deliver data-driven, scalable products that enhance user experience and business outcomes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams - Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Business - to shape products powered by AI/ML. This role requires a balance of technical understanding, strategic thinking, and strong execution to transform ideas into impactful products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for your product area.
  • Work closely with Data Science and Engineering teams to conceptualize and launch AI/ML-based features.
  • Translate business goals and user insights into detailed product requirements and user stories.
  • Analyze performance data and define evaluation metrics to measure product and model effectiveness.
  • Drive end-to-end product execution - from ideation, prioritization, and delivery to performance tracking and iteration.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality releases.
  • Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Success to ensure effective product positioning and adoption.

Required Skills

  • 2-4 years of experience in product management within a technology-driven organization.
  • Proven experience delivering successful B2B or B2C products.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven mindset.
  • Proficiency with agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence, Figma, etc.).
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Business; MBA is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to AI/ML, Deep Learning, or data-centric product development.
  • Understanding of model evaluation metrics (precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, etc.) and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience in SaaS, EdTech, FinTech, or consumer product domains.
  • Ability to work effectively with Data Science and Engineering teams to bring AI features to market.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, or GA4.
  • Experience managing multi-region or global product rollouts.

jobDescription:
Role Summary

The Implementation Analyst III role is responsible for managing customer-facing technical engagements, understanding business requirements, and coordinating solution implementation across low-code and custom application environments.

This role acts as a bridge between customers, delivery teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of business solutions aligned with customer expectations and platform capabilities.

The ideal candidate should possess a strong mix of:

  • Client communication and stakeholder management
  • Requirement gathering and solution coordination
  • Technical understanding of application development and integrations
  • Ability to work closely with development teams on execution priorities

Key Responsibilities

Customer Requirement Management

  • Interact with customers to understand business requirements and implementation expectations
  • Conduct requirement gathering sessions, workshops, and solution discussions
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical implementation inputs for delivery teams

Solution Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate with application development teams for timely implementation of customer requirements
  • Track project activities, dependencies, and delivery timelines
  • Ensure customer priorities are aligned with execution plans

Technical Consultation

  • Provide functional and technical guidance during implementation discussions
  • Understand integration requirements, APIs, workflows, and system dependencies
  • Work with teams developing solutions using low-code platforms, React, Node.js, Python, and related technologies

Client Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary coordination point for customer interactions during implementation phases
  • Provide project updates, implementation status, and issue resolution support
  • Manage customer expectations and ensure smooth communication across stakeholders

Testing & Solution Validation

  • Coordinate solution validation and UAT activities with customers
  • Ensure implemented solutions meet agreed business requirements

Process Improvement & Adoption

  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes and customer onboarding experience
  • Support adoption of AI-assisted workflows and automation approaches where applicable

Required Qualifications

Education

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field

Experience

  • 4 to 8 years of experience in implementation, application delivery, technical consulting, or customer-facing technology roles

Required Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong customer communication and requirement gathering skills
  • Good understanding of application development lifecycle and implementation processes
  • Familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms such as n8n and Node-RED
  • Working knowledge of React, Node.js, APIs, MySQL, and system integrations
  • Ability to understand technical discussions and coordinate with engineering teams
  • Strong business understanding and solution-oriented thinking
  • Good analytical and logical problem-solving skills
  • Experience in customer-facing technical discussions and stakeholder management

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to AI tools, automation workflows, or Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain
  • Experience working in product-based or SaaS implementation environments
  • Understanding of workflow automation and enterprise integrations

Making animals lives better makes life better - join our team today!

CMC Program Manager, Technical Development

Role Description

The CMC Program Manager will oversee CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) timelines and workstreams across projects within the Technical Development (TD) Functional Excellence framework. This role is pivotal for extracting information critical for resourcing, strategic decisions, and the annual Business Plan. The incumbent ensures that CMC timelines are consistent and integrated, and that resource/vendor allocation is clearly understood to meet budgetary targets.

Acting as the operational data "engine" that informs broader TD Functional Excellence scorecards and platforms, this role interfaces between TPLs, the Project Management (PM) group, and TD Functional Leaders. The incumbent leverages project management expertise and TD knowledge to drive accountability, increase transparency, and improve spending accuracy across the portfolio.

---

Key Responsibilities

CMC Timeline & Milestone Integrity

Integrated Timeline Management: Harmonize comprehensive CMC project timelines to extract critical data on siting, resource requirements, and potential constraints, enabling data-driven strategic decisions.

Critical Path & Clash Analysis: Identify dependencies and resourcing "clashes" in CMC development paths to facilitate proactive risk mitigation and siting prioritization.

TD Functional Excellence Support: Collaborate across the TD Leadership (TPLs, Functional Leaders) to integrate CMC operational frameworks (e. g. , milestone definitions, suitable KPIs, leading/lagging indicators) into broader TD standards and support initiatives as needed.

Resource Tracking

Specific Resource Tracking: Define robust mechanisms to track resource utilization (FTEs/Capacity) at the project and functional levels to flag constraints or availability.

Business Plan Support: Directly support the yearly Business Plan process by providing accurate resource forecasts and conducting "what-if" scenario modeling based on portfolio priorities or potential project accelerations.

Financial Stewardship & Budgetary Oversight

Budget Alignment & Forecasting: Partner closely with TPLs and the PM group to improve the management of project-specific CMC budgets, ensuring accuracy in forecasting and strict adherence to financial targets.

Audit & Variance Management: Proactively audit project-specific CMC spending against the Business Plan to flag variances, and improve future forecasting accuracy.

---

Bachelor or Master level degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmacy, or similar).

Several years of Project Management experience specifically within an R&D environment, with a strong focus on CMC workstreams.

Demonstrated understanding of the Technical Development (TD) space, including regulatory requirements and manufacturing interfaces.

Proven exposure to resource planning and budget management for complex programs.

Ability to work effectively and influence global, cross-functional teams with or without direct authority.

Strong experience with portfolio-level metadata and resource tracking tools.

Deep understanding of the Innovation Cycle, MR process, and Business Plan process.

Lean/6sigma experience and a mindset for process optimization.

Knowledge of R&D IT tools and an agile learner of new systems for data visualization.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Kaufman Rossin is seeking an experienced AI Developer based in Bengaluru to play a central role in building KRs AI application capability on Azure. This is a full-stack AI engineering role - spanning LLM integration, RAG architecture, API development, Azure-native deployment, local/self-hosted model operations, and responsible AI implementation - with a focus on delivering real, production-grade solutions that create measurable value for KRs advisory practice and its clients.

The ideal candidate is deeply technical, intellectually curious, pragmatic about shipping working software, and acutely aware of the cost and security implications of every architectural decision. You will work directly from well-defined user stories, collaborate with the Azure Architect on model and infrastructure decisions, and leverage Claude Code and AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of your engineering workflow.

Key Responsibilities

AI Application Development

  • Design, build, and deploy scalable AI-powered applications on Azure infrastructure - including internal productivity tools for KR staff and client-facing solutions for RAS and advisory engagements.
  • Develop and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure AI Foundry - handling document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, vector indexing, and query-time retrieval.
  • Build and maintain LLM-powered features: document intelligence, contract analysis, automated summarization, regulatory content extraction, conversational agents, and structured data extraction from unstructured sources.
  • Integrate a broad range of AI models into application workflows - including Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3), Anthropic Claude (via Azure or API), Meta Llama, Mistral, and other open-source models - selecting the right model for each use case based on capability, cost, latency, and data sensitivity requirements.
  • Stand up, configure, and maintain local/internal AI model deployments using Ollama, vLLM, or Azure AI Foundry local compute - for use cases requiring on-premises processing, data residency compliance, or cost-controlled inference at scale.
  • Leverage Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools throughout the engineering workflow - using agentic coding capabilities to accelerate development, improve code quality, generate tests, and explore solution options faster.
  • Architect multi-turn conversational interfaces and agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain - for use cases requiring reasoning, tool use, or multi-step orchestration.

Security Responsible AI

  • Apply KRs AI governance framework in every build - content filtering via Azure AI Content Safety, DLP controls, usage audit logging, data sensitivity classification, and Conditional Access enforcement for AI-powered tools.
  • Implement security best practices across all AI application components - Entra ID authentication, RBAC, Managed Identity for service-to-service access, secret management via Azure Key Vault, and Private Endpoint connectivity - treating security as a first-class design requirement, not an afterthought.
  • Implement responsible AI practices in every deliverable - input/output validation, PII detection, content filtering, audit logging, and explainability documentation for regulated advisory contexts.
  • Document model behavior, known limitations, bias considerations, and risk mitigations for each AI feature delivered - producing responsible AI summaries that satisfy KRs governance requirements for client-facing deployments.
  • Implement secure, multi-tenant data isolation patterns in AI applications - ensuring client data, internal data, and model context are correctly scoped and never cross tenant boundaries.

Cost-Conscious Architecture FinOps

  • Design AI application architectures with cost efficiency as a first-class concern - selecting models, deployment tiers, and inference patterns that deliver the required capability at the lowest sustainable cost.
  • Configure and manage Azure AI Foundry deployments - model selection, deployment slots, token quotas, rate limiting, and cost monitoring - ensuring efficient and cost-controlled model consumption.
  • Evaluate build vs. buy vs. local model decisions for each AI use case - weighing commercial API costs against self-hosted model operational costs, latency trade-offs, and data sensitivity requirements.
  • Integrate Azure Monitor and Application Insights into AI applications - instrumenting latency, token usage, error rates, and custom AI quality metrics to support ongoing cost and performance monitoring.
  • Produce regular AI cost reports - token consumption by application, model cost per query, and cost-per-outcome metrics - giving IT leadership visibility into AI spend and ROI.

Azure Infrastructure Deployment

  • Deploy AI applications and services on Azure using containerized architectures - Azure Container Apps, AKS, or Azure App Services - depending on workload requirements and scale.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for AI application workloads - automating build, test, security scan, and deployment stages through to production.
  • Implement API layers for AI capabilities using Azure API Management, Azure Functions, or FastAPI - exposing AI features to front-end applications and internal integrations in a secure, versioned, and observable way.
  • Apply infrastructure-as-code practices (Bicep or Terraform) for AI service provisioning - ensuring environments are reproducible, auditable, and aligned with KRs Azure landing zone governance.

Data Integration

  • Build data ingestion and preprocessing pipelines that prepare structured and unstructured data for AI consumption - document parsing (PDF, Word, Excel), OCR via Azure AI Document Intelligence, and schema normalization.
  • Integrate AI features with KRs enterprise data sources and application ecosystem - Azure Data Lake Storage, APIs, and internal platforms - through well-designed, maintainable integration layers.
  • Partner with KRs Architecture team on data flow design, storage tier selection, and retrieval performance optimization for knowledge bases and document stores.

Collaboration Delivery

  • Work directly from user stories, acceptance criteria, and BA specifications - asking clarifying questions proactively and flagging technical constraints or cost implications early rather than late.
  • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies - planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives - contributing estimates, surfacing blockers, and demoing completed AI features to business stakeholders with clear, non-technical explanations.
  • Collaborate with KRs Architecture team on architectural decisions, design reviews, model selection, and cost/security trade-offs.
  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation: API references, architecture decision records (ADRs), deployment runbooks, and model integration guides - so every feature is maintainable beyond the original developer.
  • Mentor junior developers on AI development patterns, Azure service usage, cost optimization, and responsible AI practices.

Required

  • 3+ years of hands-on software development, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML application development in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building production applications with LLMs across multiple model families - OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, Mistral, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines - document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, chunking strategies, and retrieval optimisation.
  • Experience standing up and operating local or self-hosted AI model deployments (Ollama, vLLM).

As a Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer at Zamp, and an early member of this function, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments while helping define how Zamps platform is deployed and operated across enterprise environments.

Many of our largest customers operate in regulated industries and require Zamp to run inside their own infrastructure rather than our cloud. You will work directly with these customers to architect, deploy, upgrade, and manage the Zamp platform in their environments, ensuring every deployment meets their security, compliance, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will typically serve as the directly responsible technical owner for a small number of strategic enterprise customers, leading each deployment from architecture and discovery through implementation, production readiness, and ongoing operations. Alongside that, you will establish the standards, tooling, and processes that make deployments repeatable, and partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.

Previous AI or machine learning experience is helpful but not required. Strong production infrastructure and Kubernetes deployment experience matters considerably more.

What youll do :

  • Own deployment architecture conversations and execution, designing and implementing deployment strategies across customer environments, including Kubernetes topology, networking, permissioning, storage, identity, and infrastructure provisioning.

  • Manage the full infrastructure lifecycle for some of Zamps most critical customers: initial deployment, ongoing upgrades, scaling, and incident support.

  • Personally configure and troubleshoot Helm releases, workloads, services, ingress, secrets, observability, and autoscaling within customer-controlled clusters.

  • Work with customers platform engineering, security, and DevOps teams to navigate their infrastructure constraints, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Translate customer security, reliability, and operational requirements into practical deployment architectures, and know when a requirement is a configuration change versus a genuine product gap.

  • Diagnose complex issues across Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, application services, databases, authentication, networking, and service dependencies, often with limited access to the environment.

  • Develop and maintain Helm configurations, deployment automation, validation tooling, runbooks, and upgrade procedures that make operations repeatable and reliable.

  • Own the deployment supply chain: image promotion, vulnerability scanning, artifact signing, and the mirroring workflows that air-gapped and restricted customers depend on.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure Zamps platform is deployable and operable across diverse customer requirements, converting customer-specific solutions into reusable platform improvements.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success to scope infrastructure requirements during pre-sales and onboarding, translating customer needs into concrete deployment plans.

What youll bring :

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or solutions architecture, with significant time spent on customer-facing deployment work.

  • Demonstrated experience personally deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes, including workloads, services, ingress, DNS, network policies, persistent storage, secrets, identity, autoscaling, and observability.

  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including networking fundamentals such as VPCs, IAM, DNS, and load balancing.

  • Hands-on experience with Helm and at least one infrastructure or deployment automation system such as Terraform, Argo CD, Flux, Kustomize, or equivalent.

  • Track record of managing deployments in customer-owned environments, including navigating security reviews, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Strong debugging skills across containers, distributed services, networking, logs, metrics, authentication, storage, and service dependencies.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with enterprise stakeholders, from platform engineers to CISOs, and turn infrastructure conversations into actionable deployment plans.

  • Strong operational instincts: you think about upgrades, rollbacks, monitoring, and failure modes from the start, not as an afterthought.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to both engineers and non-engineering stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and collaborating across engineering, product, and go-to-market teams.

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience deploying applications onto a Kubernetes platform managed entirely by another team is not sufficient on its own. Candidates should have direct experience diagnosing and resolving Kubernetes and infrastructure-level issues.

Build New Institutional Partnerships | 50% You will proactively identify and cultivate relationships with:

  • Philanthropic institutions
  • Family offices
  • Donor collaboratives
  • Bilateral and multilateral agencies
  • Global grant-making organisations
  • Other mission-aligned institutional funders

  • Research and qualify high-potential funding opportunities.
  • Build a healthy pipeline of prospective partners.
  • Proactively initiate conversations rather than relying only on incoming opportunities.
  • Understand funder priorities, strategies, geographies, grant cycles, and decision-making processes.
  • Build relationships with relevant decision-makers.
  • Identify areas of alignment between partner priorities and Muskaan Dreams programmes.
  • Move qualified opportunities systematically towards partnership.

  • Grant proposals and applications
  • Partner presentations
  • Budgets
  • Logical frameworks
  • Theories of Change
  • Implementation plans
  • Due diligence documentation
  • Supporting grant documentation

  • Ensure timely and high-quality communication.
  • Coordinate reporting and impact updates.
  • Organise review meetings and field visits.
  • Ensure commitments and deliverables are tracked internally.
  • Surface challenges proactively and transparently.
  • Create meaningful opportunities for partners to experience the work.
  • Identify opportunities for renewals and expansion.

  • Develop intelligence around emerging thematic and geographic opportunities.
  • Ensure partnership documentation is organised and accessible.
  • Use pipeline data to support fundraising planning and decision-making.

  • Communication is timely, transparent, and proactive.

  • Challenges are communicated openly.
  • Their priorities and feedback are genuinely heard.
  • They remain connected to the programmes and communities they support.
  • Impact is communicated through both evidence and powerful storytelling.
  • Muskaan Dreams thinks beyond one grant cycle.

Grow & Retain Existing Partnerships Build trusted relationships that result in strong partner satisfaction, timely renewals, multi-year partnerships, and opportunities for expansion. Create an Excellent Partner Experience Ensure partners experience Muskaan Dreams as responsive, transparent, thoughtful, credible, and committed to impact.   • 4-6 years of experience in institutional fundraising, philanthropy, partnerships, international development, grant management, programme development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience securing and/or managing institutional grants.
  • Experience working with foundations, philanthropies, family offices, bilateral/multilateral agencies, or institutional donors.
  • Strong experience developing concept notes, proposals, presentations, budgets, and donor reports.
  • Experience directly engaging with external partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience in education, technology, public systems, international development, or social impact would be valuable.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Strong storytelling and proposal-writing skills.
  • Excellent relationship-building ability.
  • Strong research and opportunity-identification skills.
  • Confidence initiating conversations with new partners.
  • Ability to understand funder priorities and identify strategic alignment.
  • Strong stakeholder and project-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple proposals and relationships simultaneously.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • High attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Comfort with targets, pipelines, and fundraising accountability.
  • Willingness to travel across India and internationally when required.

  • Deeply cares about children, education, and equitable opportunities.
  • Is naturally curious about people and enjoys building relationships.
  • Believes partnerships are built on trust and shared purpose, not transactions.
  • Is comfortable reaching out, opening doors, and creating opportunities.
  • Listen before proposing solutions.
  • Can communicate complex ideas simply.
  • Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Is responsive and dependable.
  • Is resilient-because fundraising requires patience and persistence.
  • Shares credit and believes in collective success.
  • Demonstrates integrity, humility, professionalism, and maturity.
  • I am excited by the opportunity to help build something ambitious.
This role may not be right for you if:
  • You see fundraising primarily as writing proposals.
  • You prefer waiting for RFPs rather than proactively creating opportunities.
  • You enjoy closing grants but not maintaining relationships afterwards.
  • You prefer transactional fundraising over long-term relationship building.
  • You are uncomfortable reaching out to new people or engaging senior stakeholders.
  • You struggle to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively.
  • You find follow-ups uncomfortable.
  • You struggle with deadlines, details, or structured pipeline management.
  • You prefer working independently rather than coordinating across teams.
  • You are uncomfortable being accountable for fundraising outcomes.
Why Join Muskaan Dreams Because this is an opportunity to do more than raise funds. You will help build a coalition of institutions and people who can influence what the future looks like for millions of children. You will work at the intersection of AI, education, government systems, philanthropy, and social impact. You will spend time with funders and leaders-but also with teachers, children, programme teams, and government stakeholders whose realities should shape every partnership we build. And as Muskaan Dreams grows, you will have the opportunity to build relationships, systems, and partnerships that grow with it. If you believe where a child is born should never determine how prepared they are for the future, we would love to hear from you.

  • Participate in architecture discussions and provide technical recommendations based on scalability, security, maintainability, and cost considerations.
  • Develop secure REST APIs and integrate frontend applications with backend microservices.
  • Optimize application performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across devices.
  • Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers while promoting engineering best practices.
  • Support production deployments, troubleshoot issues, and ensure application reliability.

  • 5-9 years of experience in Frontend or Full Stack development.
  • Strong expertise in React.js.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).

  • Experience with REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
  • Experience with modern frontend state management libraries (Redux, Context API, Zustand, etc.).
  • Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and UI component libraries.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Functional experience in pharma domain.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related science field or equivalent.

jobDescription:
Senior Consultant - Public Cloud and Hybrid AI Infrastructure

Capability


Public Cloud and Hybrid AI Infrastructure

Level


Senior Consultant

Primary focus


NVIDIA GPU-based AI infrastructure and AI data centres

Deployment model


Private cloud, public cloud and hybrid AI infrastructure

Role mandate


The Senior Consultant will architect, engineer and operate production NVIDIA GPU infrastructure on public cloud and connect it with private AI estates. The role covers GPU landing zones, cluster fabrics, cloud-native orchestration, performance, security, reliability and AI infrastructure FinOps.



Key responsibilities



  • Design GPU landing zones, accounts/subscriptions/projects, network topology, private connectivity, identity, encryption, policy and observability.
  • Select NVIDIA GPU instances and cluster patterns for distributed training, fine-tuning, batch inference and low-latency serving.
  • Engineer cloud GPU clusters using managed Kubernetes or HPC schedulers, placement/topology controls and high-performance network adapters.
  • Design high-throughput object, file and block storage, data ingestion, checkpointing, cache and cross-region/data-centre movement patterns.
  • Build hybrid connectivity and workload portability between private GPU clusters and public cloud.
  • Implement Terraform, image pipelines, CI/CD/GitOps, autoscaling, quota automation, reservations/capacity blocks and environment promotion.
  • Integrate cloud ML services where appropriate while retaining infrastructure controls for custom NVIDIA-based workloads.
  • Establish GPU availability, utilization, token, latency, throughput, reliability and cost observability.
  • Implement AI infrastructure FinOps covering commitments, spot/preemptible usage, idle detection, rightsizing, storage/egress and showback/chargeback.
  • Engineer security for images, drivers, model artifacts, secrets, endpoints, data residency and software supply chain.
  • Build and automate assigned infrastructure components and independently own engineering stories.
  • Execute validation, benchmarking, troubleshooting, upgrades and operational handover.
  • Create as-built documentation, test evidence, runbooks and reusable modules.


Required experience and skills



  • Typically 6-10 years in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, HPC or platform engineering, including hands-on GPU or accelerated-computing experience.
  • Strong implementation, automation, testing, troubleshooting and technical-documentation skills.
  • NVIDIA GPU architecture and systems including DGX/HGX or equivalent certified platforms.
  • GPU cluster design across compute, high-speed network, storage, control plane and management plane.
  • AI workload characteristics across distributed training, fine-tuning, RAG, batch inference, real-time inference and HPC.
  • Kubernetes/OpenShift and/or Slurm; GPU scheduling, partitioning, quotas, isolation and multi-tenancy.
  • Linux, containers, CUDA ecosystem, NCCL, drivers, firmware and GPU observability fundamentals.
  • Security, resilience, capacity, performance, automation and day-2 operations for production AI infrastructure.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud and working awareness of the other platforms.
  • Experience with cloud GPU capacity, high-performance networking, managed Kubernetes/HPC, IaC and cloud cost optimization.


Preferred profile


  • Experience in hyperscalers, GPU cloud/neocloud providers, GCC cloud platform teams or large enterprise cloud AI estates.
  • Professional cloud, NVIDIA, Kubernetes, Terraform, network or FinOps certification.
  • Experience with hybrid AI, sovereign cloud, reserved GPU capacity and production-scale inference.

Success outcomes


  • Production-ready, secure and scalable GPU infrastructure.
  • High GPU utilization, predictable application performance and reduced time to onboard AI workloads.
  • Reliable capacity expansion, platform automation and measurable cost/energy efficiency.
  • Strong client satisfaction, delivery quality and reusable engineering accelerators.

Position: Full Stack AI Engineer

Job Type: Contract to Hire(C2H)

Experience: 3+ Years
Location: Bangalore & Chennai
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Role Overview

We are building autonomous, LLM-powered agents in-house from the ground up, with no off-the-shelf vendor platform. Working alongside senior engineers, you will design, build, and ship agents that reason over internal data, call tools and APIs, and carry multi-step tasks through to completion. This is a hands-on build role where you will write production-grade Python every day and see your agents go live.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build LLM-powered agents from scratch, including prompt design, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step task orchestration.
  • Connect agents to internal databases and APIs, including SQL and data-access layers.
  • Implement retrieval pipelines (RAG), including chunking, embeddings, vector search, and relevance tuning.
  • Build evaluation harnesses to measure agent accuracy, latency, cost, and failure modes.
  • Implement guardrails, retries, error handling, and tracing to ensure predictable agent behavior in production.
  • Deploy and monitor agents on cloud infrastructure in collaboration with platform and data teams.

Essential Skills

  • 34 years of software engineering experience with strong, production-grade Python.
  • At least one LLM application built beyond tutorial level, such as a chatbot, RAG system, or agent, with the ability to explain design decisions.
  • Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models, including function/tool calling and structured outputs.
  • Strong SQL and relational database fundamentals, including schema design, joins, and query performance.
  • REST API development and integration using FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent.
  • Strong Git knowledge and familiarity with Docker.
  • Practical understanding of LLM agent failure modes, including hallucinations, context limits, tool-call errors, and runaway loops.

Cloud & Data Stack

Azure

  • Azure OpenAI Service
  • Azure AI Foundry
  • Azure AI Search
  • Azure Functions
  • Cosmos DB
  • Azure SQL
  • Azure Container Apps

AWS

  • Amazon Bedrock
  • Amazon OpenSearch or Kendra
  • AWS Lambda
  • DynamoDB
  • RDS/Aurora with pgvector
  • ECS/Fargate

Vector Stores

  • pgvector
  • Pinecone
  • Qdrant
  • Weaviate
  • Chroma

Desirable Skills

  • Agent and orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
  • Multi-agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), async, or streaming architectures.
  • LLM observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or Ragas.
  • CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep, or MLOps/LLMOps deployment experience.
  • TypeScript or Node.js for product-facing agent interfaces.
  • Open-source contributions or a public portfolio.

Are you passionate about Python and eager to apply your skills to challenging, real-world AI problems? We're looking for a bright and motivated Junior Python Engineer to join our core AI Transformation team. Job Description (JD) for an AI Professional/Specialist in the logistics industry:

Job Title: AI Professional / AI Specialist Logistics & Supply Chain
Job Summary

The AI Professional / AI Specialist will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that improve logistics and supply-chain operations.

The role will focus on applying AI to areas such as demand forecasting, route optimization, fleet management, warehouse operations, inventory optimization, shipment tracking, delivery-time prediction, customer service, fraud detection, and operational automation.

The ideal candidate should combine strong AI/ML expertise with a practical understanding of logistics, transportation, warehousing, and supply-chain processes.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI & Machine Learning Solutions

  • Develop and deploy machine-learning and AI models for logistics and supply-chain applications.
  • Build predictive models for demand, shipment volumes, delivery times, delays, and capacity requirements.
  • Apply generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate operational and customer-service processes.
  • Develop AI-based decision-support systems for logistics managers and operations teams.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve model accuracy, reliability, and business impact.

2. Route & Transportation Optimization

  • Develop AI/ML solutions for route planning and optimization.
  • Optimize vehicle allocation, delivery schedules, load planning, and transportation capacity.
  • Predict traffic-related delays and recommend alternative routes.
  • Develop Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction models.
  • Support dynamic dispatching and real-time transportation decision-making.

3. Warehouse & Inventory Optimization

  • Apply AI to warehouse demand planning, inventory optimization, and replenishment.
  • Develop solutions for warehouse slotting and picking optimization.
  • Use computer vision for package identification, damage detection, barcode recognition, and warehouse monitoring.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend AI-driven improvements.

4. Data Analytics & Forecasting

  • Analyze large datasets from ERP, TMS, WMS, GPS, IoT, telematics, and other logistics systems.
  • Develop forecasting models for demand, inventory, fleet utilization, and shipment volumes.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, inefficiencies, and operational risks.
  • Build dashboards and analytical models to support management decisions.

5. Generative AI & Automation

  • Develop AI assistants/copilots for logistics planners, customer-service teams, warehouse staff, and management.
  • Automate document processing such as invoices, bills of lading, proof of delivery, shipping documents, and customs documentation.
  • Implement AI-based email, chatbot, and customer-query automation.
  • Use NLP to extract information from unstructured logistics documents and communications.

6. AI Implementation & Integration

  • Integrate AI solutions with existing ERP, WMS, TMS, CRM, fleet-management, and IoT platforms.
  • Work with software engineers and IT teams to deploy AI models into production.
  • Develop APIs and data pipelines required for AI applications.
  • Monitor deployed models and resolve performance or data-quality issues.

  • Ensure AI solutions comply with organizational security, privacy, and governance requirements.
  • Establish appropriate controls for AI-generated decisions and recommendations.
  • Monitor model bias, accuracy, explainability, and reliability.
  • Maintain documentation of models, datasets, assumptions, and performance metrics.

  • Work closely with logistics, transportation, warehouse, procurement, finance, sales, and customer-service teams.
  • Identify business problems that can be solved through AI.
  • Translate operational requirements into AI/ML use cases.
  • Present AI insights and recommendations to senior management in business-friendly language.

  • Vector databases and RAG architectures

  • AI solution adoption by business users

  • Project management

Familiarity with prompt evaluation strategies, including manual review, automatic metrics, and A/B testing frameworks.

We are seeking a dynamic AI Engineer to join our pioneering Agentic AI team.   • Collaborate with product owners and domain experts to build reusable components for business process automation.
  • Develop core infrastructure and reusable components to support the deployment of agent-based AI systems.
  • Work on agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and LLM-powered integrations.
  • Implement scalable solutions integrated with CRM systems and enterprise data platforms.
  • Contribute to the design of modular, extensible, enterprise-grade architecture.
  • Fine-tune and evaluate AI agents for speed, accuracy, performance and maintainability across business units.

  • Bias Mitigation: Designing prompts that minimize bias and ensure fair and equitable outcomes from AI systems.

  • Support from other platform owners.
  • Agents must learn from failed interactions.
  • Building a Agents that doesn't just answer but negotiates with human-like reasoning.
  • Running large AI models in low-latency, low-bandwidth environments without cloud dependency.
